What if you reheated leftover rice every day?
Rice is a staple food for more than half of the world's people. It's quick and cheap. Leftover rice is the secret to lots of great fried rice recipes.

But here's the twist. Rice can carry spores that survive cooking, and if it sits out too long, they make toxins that reheating won't destroy. Doctors call it fried rice syndrome! Cool rice within an hour, keep it in the fridge, and eat it within a day. When you reheat it, make sure it's steaming hot all the way through.
